-12 range. Those included power, exponential, sine and log forms in t and P, and a few nested forms in t·P.

The best law I found, with NMSE 7.4e-6, is `4·sqrt(P) − sin(0.424·t)·P + 0.497·t^1.16·P^0.015·exp(−0.044·t)`. The exponents and rate constants in it look like fitting compensation, not a law.

best.code:
def equation(t, P, params):
    return params[0]*np.sqrt(P) + params[1]*np.sin(params[2]*t)*P + params[3]*t**params[4]*P**params[5]*np.exp(params[6]*t)
